entries.title: Exponential prior Poincare bound: explicit draft calculation
entries.statement: AUTHOR PROOF DRAFT; independent review pending. The rate-one exponential law, and its centered translate Exp(1)-1, have C_P<=4. For centered h use g=h exp(-y/2), integrate by parts on the half-line and use g(0)^2<=integral g_prime^2 from the centering constraint. The complete boundary and Sobolev calculation is in OPERATOR_WEIGHTED_COUNTEREXAMPLE.md section 1. No novelty is claimed.
assumptions: Finite variance and finite weighted derivative energy; other cases follow by the extended-energy interpretation

entries.title: Draft obstruction to a variance-weighted posterior covariance surrogate
entries.statement: AUTHOR COUNTEREXAMPLE DRAFT; independent review pending. In dimension one, no universal T>0 and finite K bound B_mu(t,f)=E[A_t Var(f(X)|Y_t)]/E Var(f(X)|Y_t) for all compact isotropic log-concave priors, all fixed smooth f and almost every t in (0,T), where Y_t=tX+sqrt(t)G and A_t=Var(X|Y_t). For the original prior X=Exp(1)-1 and f_c=exp(cx), B_mu(t,f_c) tends to 1/t as c increases to 1/2. Under the f_c^2 weighting used in the proof, A_t is still the ORIGINAL prior posterior variance. Truncation and whitening transfer a strict violation to compact priors and a time interval. This challenges the stronger operator-norm surrogate only; the actual estimate E|Cov_mu_t(f,X)|^2<=K E Var_mu_t(f) remains a separate unproved input. The full derivation and limit domination are in OPERATOR_WEIGHTED_COUNTEREXAMPLE.md. No parent solution or novelty claim is made.
assumptions: The counterexample concerns the stronger operator-norm variance-weighted estimate, not the actual covariance estimate (W)
The compact transfer uses recentering, whitening and smooth tests agreeing with the exponential on compact prior support
